input: create table orders (id integer primary key, customer_id integer not null references customers(id),
status varchar(20) default 'pending', total decimal(10,2), created_at timestamp);
with recent as (select customer_id, sum(total) as spent from orders where created_at > current_date - interval '30 days' group by customer_id)
case when r.spent > 1000 then 'gold' when r.spent > 100 then 'silver' else 'bronze' end as tier
from customers c inner join recent r on r.customer_id = c.id left join addresses a on a.customer_id = c.id
where c.active = true and (a.country = 'CA' or a.country is null)
update orders set status='shipped' where id in (select order_id from shipments where shipped_at is not null);
